body:
Follow-up to `slosh-twin` (its listed next step): ZV/ZVD input-shaped moves of a liquid-carrying cart.

- Exact law: shaped residual = V(ε) × unshaped, V = |sin(πε/2)| (ZV), sin²(πε/2) (ZVD); verified against exact propagation.
- Designed at full tank, both shapers stay within 1 cm down to 10% fill (5.90 s / 6.90 s) vs 8 s / 28 s for null-tuned moves.
- Closed-form tolerated frequency error; damped variants; fill-band design (flagged: zero margin).
- README, whitepaper, tests (9), `README.md` bullet and `site/projects.json` entry; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
